Nintendo Land.name: Nintendo Land
Nintendo Land.summary: Nintendo Land is a fun and lively virtual theme park filled with attractions based on popular Nintendo game worlds. Explore the Nintendo Land Plaza as your Mii character, and play in park attractions featuring unique and innovative gameplay made possible by the Wii U GamePad controller. Enjoy team, competitive, and solo gameplay experiences for up to five players!
developers: Nintendo EAD Software Development Group No.2
